conf.description: siem-software-factory POC: turn Splunk search export lines back into the original events, with their Splunk metadata and collection metadata (sf_*). Used only by collector poc-splunk-search.

conf.comment: Input: one Splunk export line per event (breaker poc-splunk-search-json). Output: _raw/_time/host/source/sourcetype/index of the ORIGINAL event, plus sf_* fields. The export wrapper never reaches the output.

functions.description: Unwrap result, restore original event and metadata
Not an event, a preview row, or from the dev index
Keep only the sample schema fields
